candidateOccurrences.sourceText: The border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that faces the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the river. The border passed along to the waters of En Shemesh, and ended at En Rogel.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: The border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: The border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem) southward; and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the farthest part of the valley of Rephaim northward.
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: It extended northward, went out at En Shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. It went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: The border went down to the farthest part of the mountain that lies before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of Rephaim northward. It went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En Rogel.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: It passed along to the side opposite the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。
